rationale.consistency: Excellent adherence to Go and repository conventions, including flag handling and layout.
rationale.edge_cases: Properly detects name collisions, handles bare/worktree repos, and locks index strictly honoring dry-runs.
rationale.scope: Implements all requirements precisely without unrelated refactoring or changes.
rationale.readability: Clean separation of concerns across files, well-named functions, and tabwriter output for list.
rationale.robustness: Lock file creation with O_EXCL prevents race conditions, and walk handles permissions/missing dirs gracefully.
rationale.maintainability: Extremely clean flag abstraction and decoupled subcommand logic make it easy to extend.
